messages.subject: Source audit complete: changes required, native hold retained
messages.body: Completed the independent frozen-source audit and wrote prefill-api-independent-review-v1.md plus its hashed JSON companion. Found high-priority missing C++20 target enforcement and native PLE key extent admission, plus fixed PLE table domain, small-input gate, bounded QSA cleanup and optional capture-close issues. SOURCE_ONLY_UNSAFE_TO_RUN remains; Main must review corrections and separate build, host, provider and numerical gates, with no executions performed by this worker.
